decision.question: In the edited image, is a mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
decision.criteria: Inspect the edited image and compare the visible mug or mugs with the headphones. Pass only if a mug is clearly positioned to the right of the headphones. Fail if the image reliably shows no mug to their right. Use unknown if the objects or their relative positions cannot be determined reliably. This condition checks the requested final spatial relation only; a pass does not establish that the source mug itself was moved.
decision.binding: The mug or mugs and the headphones in the edited image; assess their visible left-to-right positions.
